notion._note: Get IDs from your Notion database URL. The 32-char string after notion.so/ is the page/database ID. Remove any hyphens.

apis._note: Get Adzuna keys at https://developer.adzuna.com — free tier, 250 req/day. Get Reed key at https://www.reed.co.uk/developers — free. Get RapidAPI key at https://rapidapi.com (covers JSearch + Indeed Scraper) — subscribe to both APIs on free tier. Get Notion token at https://notion.so/profile/integrations — create an Internal Integration, then share your database with it.
